anomalies.observed: C61, a 22 µF X7R 1206 ceramic, is connected between the isolated I2C data line /SDA_pH (U3 pin 18, SDA_1 side, and M2 pin 3) and the isolated supply /V_pH. The other decoupling on the same isolated supply (C18, C23) is correctly between /V_pH and /GNDISO_pH, but C61 is not.
anomalies.expected: A bulk decoupling capacitor for the isolated EZO-pH supply should sit between /V_pH and /GNDISO_pH, as C18 and C23 do. The I2C data line should not have a 22 µF capacitor to a supply rail.
anomalies.impact: A 22 µF capacitor on the SDA line to the isolated supply distorts and loads the pH EZO I2C bus, which can corrupt or block communication with the pH circuit. It also leaves the isolated pH supply with no bulk decoupling to its own isolated ground.

anomalies.observed: The gate node of the main-pump low-side MOSFET T2 (/G_PUMP) is pulled UP to +3V3 by R5 (10 kΩ). The matching ATO gate node /G_ATO is pulled DOWN to GND by R12 (10 kΩ). The pump gate pull is therefore inverted relative to the ATO gate pull.
anomalies.expected: A pull-down from the gate of a low-side N-MOSFET to GND, as on the ATO channel (R12 to GND), keeps the pump off when T1 and the ESP32 pin are inactive. A pull-up to +3V3 turns IRLR2905 T2 on whenever the pre-driver BJT is off, including at boot and reset, which runs the 24 V main pump uncontrolled.
anomalies.impact: The main circulation pump may energise at power-up, reset, or whenever the ESP32 GPIO is high-impedance, rather than staying off until firmware drives it. This is a safety and behaviour fault for the 24 V pump.

parsed.summary: Two likely deviations: C61 (22 µF) is wired from the isolated SDA_pH I2C line to the isolated V_pH supply instead of being supply decoupling, and R5 pulls the main-pump MOSFET gate up to +3V3 while the equivalent ATO gate is pulled down to GND, so the pump may turn on by default.
